messages:
anika: quick sync — Finley (enterprise) asked for inter-pool burst transfers so unused burst in Pool A can be used by Pool B during spikes. they want: transfer + accounting + per-tenant cap. asking for launch decision by EOW.

leo: hmm. inter-pool transfer is doable but surfaces preemption ordering and SLA clarity. do we mean hard transfer (move credits) or runtime spillover (borrow then repay)?

sam: borrowing (spillover) is much simpler operationally. no ledger change — requests route to other pools, charge back to origin tenant. harder part is telemetry + billing reconciliation.

maya: customer insists on clear accounting — they want to see transferred credits on invoices, not just latencies. compliance team will need audit logs.

anika: scope options: 1) Spillover only (soft borrow) + trace IDs for reconciliation. 2) Ledger transfer (permanent move) + billing UI + contract terms. 3) Hybrid: spillover + optional convert-to-credit within 24h with approvals. thoughts on MVP?

leo: from infra POV MVP = (1). we can add trace context to requests: `X-Burst-Origin: pool-A` and reconcile daily. preemption rule: borrowed work is lowest priority in destination pool.

sam: agree. implement routing + lowest-priority tags. add throttles so borrow can't exceed X% of destination capacity (configurable).

anika: product side: launch criteria for MVP (spillover): a) config flag per tenant to opt in, b) metrics surfaced in Console (borrowed_tokens, repay_rate), c) billing trace export for ERP. d) canary with up to 3 customers.

maya: + customer sign-off checklist: sample invoice with transfer lines, runbook for dispute, 90d audit log retention.

capacity-bot: Scheduled job created: `burst-reconcile` runs daily, target window: 02:00 UTC, retains 90d.

sam: proto config snippet for autoscale & borrow cap: ```json
{"autoscale": {"min":1,"max":8,"policy":"latency_slo"}, "burst_transfer": {"mode":"spillover","borrow_pct_limit": 0.15, "preempt_priority":"borrowed_low"}}
```

leo: ops caveat: borrowed_low priority still needs eviction signals; ensure fallback model routing doesn't violate tail-latency SLOs for destination pool tenants. add SLO gate so borrow pauses when p95 > target.

anika: agreed. action items: @sam build prototype routing + header + borrow cap (ETA 1w), @leo add SLO gate + preemption behavior doc (ETA 1w), @maya draft customer checklist + sample invoice (ETA 3d). i'll draft launch criteria doc and canary run plan.

maya: i'll loop Finley in for canary offer. they prefer the convert-to-credit path but can start with spillover if invoicing lines are visible.

sam: noted. I'll push PR with config and a simple reconciler + logs to `s3://reconcile-prod/finley/` for the canary.

anika: perfect — keeping scope tight for EOW decision. if any blockers ping here. :raised_hands:
